projects.title: What we have already glazed
projects.description: A short cut of projects until the full portfolio launches.

residential-complex-dushanbe.title: Residential complex in Dushanbe
residential-complex-dushanbe.caption: 240 flats glazed with the STELLA system for higher thermal insulation.
body: The complex was handed over in phases: surveying and fitting ran alongside the floors being completed, so production followed the developer's pace.
The five-chamber STELLA profile was chosen for the thermal requirements of the upper floors and for one colour across the whole facade.

business-center-khujand.title: Business centre in Khujand
business-center-khujand.caption: Facade glazing in the THERMO aluminium system with panoramic openings.
body: The panoramic openings were closed with warm aluminium: a cold system over that area would not have held the heat loss.
The units were assembled in our own workshop and shipped in batches to match the site's fitting schedule.

private-house-vahdat.title: Private house in Vahdat
private-house-vahdat.caption: ROLLER windows and doors for a private house with baseline insulation.
body: A private house with non-standard openings: half the units were made to individual sizes after the survey.
The client picked the golden oak lamination to match the tone of the facade finish.

shopping-mall-bokhtar.title: Shopping centre in Bokhtar
shopping-mall-bokhtar.caption: UNOPEN entrance groups and shopfronts for a shopping centre.
shopping-mall-bokhtar.installed: UNOPEN and ALD-45, shopfronts and doors
body: Shopfronts and entrance groups for a mall: PVC on the glazed units, cold aluminium on the doors and partitions.
Two systems on one site is ordinary practice — the material is chosen per detail, not for the building as a whole.

apartment-renovation-dushanbe.title: Flat renovation in Dushanbe
apartment-renovation-dushanbe.caption: Window units replaced in 80 flats using the cold glazing system.
body: Balcony glazing in a residential block: a light cold system that puts no load on the slab.
The work went apartment by apartment so residents could stay at home during the fitting.

warranty.title: Warranty terms
warranty.intro: The warranty covers profile systems of our own manufacture, provided the installation and use conditions are met.
terms: White PVC profile — 5 years from the date the project is handed over.
Laminated profile and aluminium systems — on the terms recorded in the contract for the project.
Hardware and components are covered to the extent of the hardware manufacturer's own warranty.
The warranty holds where the units were fitted by the company or by a certified crew and the use conditions are observed.
It does not cover mechanical damage, unauthorised alterations to the unit, or the consequences of misuse.
warranty.note: Exact durations and the scope of the obligations for a given project are recorded in the contract — ask when the costing is prepared.
